item.title: Dubai International Airport Hit Amid Iranian Missile Wave; Regional Airspace Shut, Flights Disrupted
item.description: The world’s busiest international airport, Dubai International Airport, was struck on Saturday during a wave of Iranian missile and drone attacks launched in response to US-Israeli strikes on Tehran and other Iranian cities. item.description: SRINAGAR: Hundreds of Kashmiri Shia Muslims on Sunday staged a peaceful protest in Srinagar following reports of the killing of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in alleged US-Israeli strikes.
